Ready in three steps

  1. DownloadOpen the Google Drive folder and save Amber.exe.
  2. Give it a folderPut it in its own folder, such as Desktop\Amber. Your files are saved beside it.
  3. Open and pasteLaunch Amber, paste a link in Browse or Download, and go.

Good to know

Where are my files saved?

Beside Amber.exe. Give Amber its own folder, such as Desktop\Amber, and your downloads, queue and settings all stay inside it.

Do I need to install anything?

No installer. Amber runs from a single Amber.exe. If the window opens blank, install the Microsoft WebView2 Runtime.

Windows says it protected my PC. Is Amber safe?

Windows shows that screen for new apps that not many people have downloaded yet. It does not mean something is wrong. Only download Amber from the link on this page. To open it, click More info, then Run anyway. If you want to be sure first, right-click Amber.exe and scan it with Windows Security, or upload it to virustotal.com.

Does the demo download anything?

No. The demo uses sample songs and videos. Nothing is fetched from YouTube or saved to your device. The real app does both.

Is it okay to save any video?

Save only what you have the right to keep. Amber is for personal use, and copying YouTube content may breach YouTube's Terms of Service.
